name: sol-advisor
description: Lightweight native collaboration with scouts, workers, optional reviewers and explicit task ownership.

interface.shortDescription: Focused agents with direct collaboration and clear ownership.
interface.longDescription: Delegate by task pattern to scouts, workers and optional reviewers. Select a GPT-6 model and effort at spawn, with Luna high or above. Share evidence directly, preserve ownership and authorization, and integrate results with quality and total cost in mind. Existing agents keep their model and effort.
defaultPrompt: Match task patterns to native roles and explicitly select a GPT-6 model and effort at spawn.
Let teammates share dependent evidence directly while preserving task ownership and authorization.
Integrate actual changes and check evidence; use independent review only when it improves the outcome.
